status.description: ok when live data answered the question. needs_input when required coordinates were missing so no tool was called. no_data when a tool ran but the provider has no coverage or returned nothing. error when a tool failed.

summary.description: A few sentences answering the question in plain language, leading with the most important fact.

findings.description: The individual data points behind the summary. Empty when status is needs_input.

label.description: What was measured or observed, for example Temperature or Max slope.

value.description: The value as text, exactly as the tool reported it.

unit.description: The unit the tool reported, or null when the value is unitless.

caveats.description: Limits on how far this report can be trusted. Must be non-empty when status is no_data or error, or when live data came back but is partial, approximate, or expiring.
